Phase 1b of the respec cycle (parent by title: 'Respec: agent-first VSDD toolkit on the crosslink chassis'). Scope per the phase-1b primer's four questions and the recorded phase-1a exit: purity boundaries for the toolkit; automatable-versus-manual classification; phase-5 candidates; trust boundaries; the falsifiability instruments (convergence fixture corpus and isolation mechanics); and the phase-state-location decision against its five recorded criteria. Deliverable: the ratified contract gains its Verification architecture section and the phase-state open question resolves, via the spec-review loop (draft, cold round, operator ratification).
